ffq_the_flagship_wardens.description: The general won't leave the Moorage now, not this close to sailing. Her Flagship Wardens hold the gangway, and her Ascendant Battlemages hold the pier. I want the way cleared. If you clear them off, she'll have to come out and see to it herself, because she always does. I'll be there when you face her.
ffq_the_flagship_wardens.accept_text: Clear her Wardens off the gangway and her Battlemages off the pier, and she'll come down to see why.
